name: dpaternina/page-state
title: Only on some pages
description: A container that renders only when the archive it sits in is in a particular state — more than one page, or the last page of several. The canvas has no page number, so the editor always draws it; the front end is where the state exists.

variations.name: paginated
variations.title: Only when paginated
variations.description: Renders only when the archive runs to more than one page. The design's pager bar — its rule, its margin and its range line — is drawn by this, so a one-page archive gets no stray line above nothing.

variations.name: last-page
variations.title: Only on the last page
variations.description: Renders only on the last page of an archive that has more than one. The design's closing panel.
